designationHistory.indexText: The refuge was established in 1980 and is part of the 2,800-acre Tijuana River National Estuarine Research Reserve, one of only 30 such reserves in the United States.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
